question: Raga 'Laswanti' was composed by whom among the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Ali Akbar Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Raga 'Laswanti'** was composed by the legendary sarod maestro Ustad Ali Akbar Khan.
 
• Ustad Ali Akbar Khan was renowned for his mastery in Hindustani classical music and his ability to create innovative ragas.
 
• He was one of the first Indian musicians to bring Indian classical music to Western audiences, earning him global recognition.
 
• Known as the "Sarod Samrat" (Emperor of Sarod), his contributions to the Maihar Gharana and Indian music remain unparalleled.
 
• Raga 'Laswanti' is a unique creation that reflects his deep understanding of melody, rhythm, and the intricacies of Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ronu Majumdar:**

 
 
• Ronu Majumdar is a renowned Indian flautist specializing in the bansuri (bamboo flute).
 
• He belongs to the Maihar Gharana and has worked extensively in both Hindustani classical and fusion music.
 
• Although he is a master of classical ragas, he is not associated with the creation of Raga 'Laswanti'.
 
 
 
• **Tansen:**
 
 
• Tansen was one of the Navratnas (nine gems) in the court of Mughal Emperor Akbar and is considered one of the greatest composers in Indian classical music.
 
• He is credited with creating several ragas, including Miyan ki Todi and Darbari Kanada.
 
• However, Raga 'Laswanti' is not among the ragas attributed to Tansen.
 
 
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan:**
 
 
• Amjad Ali Khan is a celebrated sarod maestro known for his innovations in Indian classical music.
 
• He belongs to the Senia Bangash Gharana and is highly respected for his contributions to sarod playing.
 
• While he has performed and popularized many ragas, he is not associated with the creation of Raga 'Laswanti'.
 
 
 
• **Maihar Gharana:**
 
 
• Founded by Baba Allauddin Khan, the Maihar Gharana is a prominent school of Hindustani classical music.
 
• It emphasizes both vocal and instrumental music, with notable musicians such as Ustad Ali Akbar Khan, Pandit Ravi Shankar, and Annapurna Devi being associated with this gharana.
 
• The gharana is known for its innovative approach to traditional Indian music, as exemplified by creations like Raga 'Laswanti'.
